Lower Text: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If it's your turn, search your security stack. This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Three Great Angels] trait among them with the digivolution cost reduced by 2. Then, shuffle your security stack. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from the hand at the bottom of your security stack.
